result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection that is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking basic infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, sidewalks, or pedestrian signals. The expansive roadway width and lack of refuge areas create significant exposure for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway creates a very long unprotected crossing distance, increasing pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to establish a clear pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised median refuge islands to reduce the unprotected crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Build a continuous sidewalk network connecting to the intersection to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians to wait and travel.

result.summary: The intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals. The wide, multi-lane roadway creates a hostile environment with long unprotected crossing distances.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk on the road shoulder or in traffic lanes.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, characterized by a complete lack of dedicated crossing infrastructure at a large, multi-lane intersection.
